Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field
What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.

Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.

We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued Skills And Experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard - and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possibleYou love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: MARIA FILÓ | Coordenador de CRM
description:
Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

O Coordenador de CRM terá um papel estratégico no fortalecimento da área como peça-chave na performance do negócio, liderando projetos transformacionais que integram dados, comportamento de consumo e performance. Atuará na construção de jornadas mais inteligentes e personalizadas, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da base ativa e o fortalecimento da nossa marca. Se você tem perfil analítico, pensamento estratégico e acredita no poder do CRM como motor de conexão e resultado, essa vaga é pra você!

  • Estruturar e evoluir os processos da área de CRM, com foco em dados e performance.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de aquisição e retenção a partir de análises de comportamento de consumo.
  • Construir e revisar réguas de relacionamento alinhadas aos direcionais da marca.
  • Garantir a qualidade da base de dados e segmentações estratégicas.
  • Construir a projeção de crescimento da base ativa com base no perfil de consumo dos clientes e orçamento de resultado anual da marca;
  • Conectar o CRM a outras áreas do negócio, como comercial, branding e canais físicos.
  • Gerenciar os canais de comunicação CRM (SMS, E-mail e WhatsApp) garantindo eficiência e comunicação assertiva;
  • Propor melhorias com base na análise de resultados e testes A/B.
  • Pesquisar ferramentas e soluções que ampliem o potencial da área.
  • Necessário residir no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Ensino superior completo em Comunicação, Marketing, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Perfil analítico, com domínio avançado de Excel e uso de Google Analytics;
  • Experiência em estratégias de CRM com foco em dados, aquisição e retenção;
  • Vivência em varejo B2C e entendimento de comportamento de consumo;
  • Desejável: experiência em BI, planejamento ou áreas de dados; interação com áreas diversas do negócio;
  • Diferenciais: conhecimento em Dito, SQL e Python;
SOMOS O MAIOR GRUPO DE MODA DO BRASIL

Por aqui, a gente inova e renova o mercado da moda do nosso jeito, arregaçando as mangas e fazendo os resultados acontecerem na nossa frente. Somos uma grande e eficiente união de talentos e expertises.

Seja nos times criativos, escritórios, lojas e fábricas, cada pessoa aqui é muito importante no nosso universo. E acreditamos de verdade que o brilho no olho do nosso time é o que faz a gente ir cada vez mais longe.

Nossa missão é sonhar grande e fazer gigante. Porque gente é o que SOMA.

title: Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI
description:
Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI

Light – Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI que será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para a Light !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
  • Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
  • Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
  • Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
  • Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).
  • Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores.
  • Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade.
  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.
Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório).
  • Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443.
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.
  • Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP.
  • Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).
Informações adicionais

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

title: Assistente de Farmácia - Oncologia
description:
Assistente de Farmácia (Glória)

Descrição
Assistente de Farmácia para atuar em nossa clínica oncológica, oferecendo suporte às atividades técnicas e administrativas da farmácia. O profissional será responsável por auxiliar no controle, organização, armazenamento e dispensação de medicamentos e materiais, assegurando a conformidade com as normas de segurança, rastreabilidade e boas práticas em oncologia.

Principais Atividades
  • Apoiar o farmacêutico nas rotinas de dispensação e conferência de medicamentos oncológicos e de suporte.
  • Realizar o recebimento, armazenamento e controle de validade de medicamentos e materiais hospitalares.
  • Executar lançamentos de entradas e saídas no sistema de gestão hospitalar.
  • Separar e preparar kits de medicamentos para quimioterapia e infusões sob supervisão do farmacêutico.
  • Manter atualizados os registros de controle de temperatura e umidade dos ambientes e equipamentos da farmácia.
  • Realizar o controle de estoque e inventário periódico.
  • Apoiar o processo de devolução, descarte e rastreabilidade de medicamentos.
  • Garantir a organização, limpeza e cumprimento das normas sanitárias da área.
  • Apoiar no atendimento aos setores assistenciais (enfermagem, consultórios, infusão) para fornecimento de materiais e medicamentos.
  • Cumprir as políticas de segurança, biossegurança e boas práticas de armazenamento e dispensação.
Requisitos
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Curso técnico em Farmácia completo ou cursando (obrigatório).

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) role at InPlanet

Join to apply for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) role at InPlanet

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Direct message the job poster from InPlanet

About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people experience the interview process with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

Informative Video by Matyas

Hybrid, with travel in Brazil

Language Skills: Must: Portuguese, English (fluent)

Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We are searching for a seasoned, strategic, commercial, and hands-on COO to lead and shape our go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors and evolve our operational backbone. In this role, you’ll oversee our entire value chain - from mineral inputs and field operations to our internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

This is a rare opportunity to refine product-market fit , identify scalable customer use cases, lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling in one of the world’s most promising carbon removal approaches. On the operational front, you will work closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations , who leads the charge on regional management, farmer acquisition, and the logistical execution of rock powder spreading across Brazil. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our VP of Science , ensuring that our field strategy is aligned with our scientific standards, operational goals, and long-term climate impact targets - building a delivery system that is not only efficient, but deeply trusted by our farming partners.

As a core strategic and visionary player, you’ll work cross-functionally to ensure our product offering is differentiated and delivers real agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements. You’ll be responsible for orchestrating our 1-100 scale-up journey : evolving early pilots into robust, repeatable, and high-impact operations at national scale.

We’re at a tipping point of scale, with growing complexity across teams, partners, and international ecosystems. The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , ideally in Brazilian agribusiness , and can bridge execution with innovation.

You will report directly to the CEO and be a critical member of our Senior Leadership Team alongside our CFO. You’ll directly lead a large and growing team, including:

  • Head of Operations and all project deployment teams including Supply and Regional Managers
  • Our Science team, in close partnership with the VP of Science
  • Collaboration with Carbon, and Technology teams
  • Strategic collaboration with our Chief Impact Officer, and commercial partners

You’ll play a central role in aligning science, fieldwork, and operations , ensuring we stay ahead in the rapidly evolving climate and carbon removal landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • You’ll help define and scale a novel carbon removal product - taking it from early traction to being a key player in agriculture and mining. This is a 1-100 leadership role, demanding bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil, with scalability in mind.
  • Translate InPlanet’s carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational KPIs, systemisation, and performance data.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • You’ll drive go-to-market strategies that bring breakthrough mineral products into entrenched agricultural systems, building the trust and partnerships needed for national adoption. Commercial creativity and strategic grit will be essential.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder - from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with carbon standards, farmer requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to ensure smooth integration of R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • You’ll bridge science and market, ensuring our product not only works in trials but wins in the real world. Field feedback will shape product evolution and create operational systems that scale with credibility and speed.
  • Support the legal team to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • You’ll build a leadership culture that’s entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable - turning high performers into high-impact owners. Your teams will know not just what to do, but why it matters.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You’ve scaled something from messy beginnings to market success - ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic - able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change
  • Competitive Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Hybrid Remote: ideally around Sao Paulo
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

Responsibilities

  • Responsável pela solução de problemas relacionados à conformidade regulatória, além de conduzir e desenvolver atividades de apoio e consultoria interna às áreas-fim da Companhia, com vistas ao atendimento das obrigações regulatórias e aprovação de projetos;
  • Responsável pela elaboração de documentos/relatórios de natureza regulatória, como PAT/PAP, BMP, Planos de Desenvolvimento, DAIA/DAPA, dentre outros, além de realizar os respectivos procedimentos nos sistemas da ANP (SEI, i-ENGINE, DPP, i-SIMP, SISO);
  • Responsável por desenvolver e promover melhorias em processos para gestão do compliance regulatório perante as autoridades reguladoras, em especial a ANP;
  • Responsável por acompanhar a evolução regulatória do setor, participando de reuniões e grupos de trabalho das associações da indústria (IBP, ABPIP, dentre outras), além de participar e elaborar sugestões de alterações regulatórias em consultas e audiências públicas.
Qualifications

  • Conhecimento do setor de O&G, especialmente na Exploração e Produção.
Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você possa nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado.

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, para conhecer os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

title: Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager
description:
5 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical

Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.

Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.

The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.

The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.

If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.

Location: We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.

What your day will look like

  • Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
  • Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical's current and future products.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.
  • Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.
  • Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
  • Negotiate successful contracts.

What we are looking for in you

  • B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
  • Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.
  • Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.
  • Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
  • Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
  • Team leadership or program management experience.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

A equipe de Metadados tem como principais funções a catalogação dos datasets e atributos de toda a empresa, gerenciamento de bases de log dos produtos e gerenciamento de bancos de dados otimizados.

O time em que essa pessoa ficará alocada é responsável por cuidar dos logs dos produtos, estruturando a arquitetura necessária para armazenamento e gestão destes logs e as interfaces necessárias para os times de produto interagirem.

A equipe dedica uma parte significativa de seu tempo e esforço ao estudo e à documentação, não se concentrando exclusivamente ao desenvolvimento.

O que vai fazer no dia a dia
  • Colaborar com as demais equipes técnicas para entender os diferentes tipos de usos para os logs de produtos;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter estrutura para armazenamento e gerenciamento dos logs de produtos;
  • Implementar práticas e padrões para documentação e descrição de conjuntos de dados e processos;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas e interfaces para facilitar a visualização, busca e análise de dados.
Requisitos
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software, com ênfase em sistemas distribuídos e de larga escala;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação orientadas a objeto, tais como C#, Python, Java, ou similar;
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias de banco de dados (SQL e NoSQL)
O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos
  • Experiência em ambiente de computação em nuvem, especialmente AWS

  • Escritório em RJ e SP com ambiente de trabalho descontraído (para quem quiser utilizar)

title: Software Engineer - Python and K8s
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

Responsibilities
  • Work in Python to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work across the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Learn to think rigorously about application and infrastructure reliability
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Simplify open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Work from home with global travel once or twice a year for up to 2 weeks for events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one public cloud
  • You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes
  • You are an experienced Python programmer and enjoy challenging projects
  • You understand the importance of reliable software and strive to design and code to that expectation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software
What we offer colleagues
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging)
description:
Overview

Role: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging) at Canonical. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you
  • You have expertise in Python.
  • You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.
  • You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.
  • Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.
  • Use your familiarity with languages, toolchains, frameworks, integrations, and CI systems to extend the snap build ecosystem
  • Work with external open source and commercial projects to understand how we can better serve community needs.

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Somos uma empresa de cibersegurança orientada a viabilizar as estratégias de negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções seguras, flexíveis e inovadoras.

Atuamos no Brasil desde 1998, integrando soluções de última geração reconhecidas pelo Gartner, Forrester e pelos nossos clientes.

Descrição do cargo:

Como Comercial de Cybersecurity, você será responsável por identificar, desenvolver e gerenciar oportunidades de negócios na área de cibersegurança. Seu papel será fundamental para impulsionar as vendas de soluções de segurança cibernética, construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e prospects, e garantir que as necessidades de segurança sejam atendidas de forma eficaz. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e externas para oferecer soluções que protejam os ativos e dados dos clientes contra ameaças cibernéticas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar e prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de negócios na área de cibersegurança.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas para alcançar metas de receita e expansão de mercado.
  • Manter um pipeline robusto de oportunidades de vendas e conduzir negociações com prospects.
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e prospects, entendendo suas necessidades de segurança e oferecendo soluções personalizadas.
  • Atuar como o principal ponto de contato para questões relacionadas a cibersegurança, oferecendo suporte e consultoria ao longo do ciclo de vendas.
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de pré-venda e consultoria para entender os requisitos técnicos dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas.
  • Apresentar e demonstrar soluções de cibersegurança, destacando os benefícios e o valor agregado das soluções.
  • Analisar o mercado e as tendências de cibersegurança para identificar novas oportunidades e ajustar estratégias de vendas.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing para desenvolver campanhas e materiais de suporte às vendas.
  • Monitorar o progresso das vendas e garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de vendas e previsões para a liderança, fornecendo insights sobre desempenho e áreas de melhoria.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas de soluções de cibersegurança ou em um papel comercial semelhante.
  • Conhecimento sólido de conceitos e práticas de cibersegurança, incluindo ameaças, vulnerabilidades e soluções de proteção.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação excepcionais, com capacidade para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara e acessível.

title: Gerente de Vendas - Trul Hotéis
description:
Sobre Nós:

O prazer é todo nosso ; )

Cada hotel tem uma característica especial. Muitas vezes, o grande desafio é encontrar qual e desenvolver o seu potencial. Por isso, a Trul é a primeira operadora multimarcas de Minas Gerais a aplicar o conceito de Customização Hoteleira. O que, em outras palavras, significa entender o que um hotel tem de melhor para, assim, desenvolver marcas e experiências únicas para o hóspede.

A Trul é detalhista e completa: cuida da implantação à operação hoteleira. Acompanha cada detalhe para garantir a gestão eficiente e necessária para atrair clientes e, claro, criar motivos para que eles voltem sempre. =)

Descrição:

Atuar estrategicamente e de forma prática na prospecção de clientes, manutenção de contas e desenvolvimento de parcerias, visando o aumento da receita do hotel. Responsável pelo plano de vendas, análise de mercado e alcance de metas comerciais, com ou sem gestão de equipe.

Atividades:

  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado em busca de oportunidades de negócios, utilizando técnicas de vendas de forma eficaz, com o objetivo de atingir as metas individuais, da TRUL HOTÉIS e de seus parceiros.
  • Prospectar e captar clientes para a TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros, sendo responsável pelo primeiro contato e pelo registro no sistema, comprometendo-se a manter as informações sempre atualizadas.
  • Desenvolver relacionamentos com agências de viagens, operadoras de turismo, companhias aéreas, contas corporativas (empresas) e demais geradores de negócios para a TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros.
  • Mapear a região primária, secundária e regiões metropolitanas de atuação, identificando clientes potenciais e otimizando recursos para evitar custos e deslocamentos desnecessários.
  • Posicionar estrategicamente os hotéis representados junto às contas-chave (Key Accounts) da praça ou região, atendendo suas necessidades e contribuindo para o aumento do share da TRUL HOTÉIS.
  • Atualizar regularmente todas as informações referentes às contas, rotinas e leads no sistema, bem como arquivos relacionados (tarifários, acordos, termos de convênio, contratos de grupos e eventos, entre outros).
  • Planejar, desenvolver e executar planos de ação comercial semestrais, apoiando colegas e equipes internas, com foco na fidelização das contas sob sua gestão e no incremento da produção da TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros.
  • Realizar análises, levantamento de dados e pesquisas de performance das contas, buscando constantemente o aumento da produção ou a manutenção dos resultados obtidos.
  • Vender e fomentar o relacionamento dos clientes com os demais hotéis da TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros, negociando condições comerciais sempre alinhadas com os pares, o Head de Vendas e os Gerentes Gerais.
  • Realizar follow-ups para atualização de tarifários, negociações e contratos preferenciais.
  • Revisar orçamentos e propostas com foco em conversão.
  • Coletar feedbacks pós-venda.
  • Tratar reclamações ou problemas em conjunto com as equipes operacionais, o Head de Vendas e os Gerentes Gerais, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar da construção e desenvolvimento de estratégias em conjunto com os pares, equipe interna, Revenue Management (RM) e Marketing, visando atingir as metas definidas no Budget anual.
  • Acompanhar o andamento das ações estratégicas de Marketing, participando ativamente das reuniões com o time interno, sempre que solicitado.
  • Realizar ações de fidelização, ativações, visitas e apresentações de novidades, produtos e serviços da TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros, mantendo o relacionamento ativo com os clientes.
  • Apresentar semanalmente ao Head Nacional de Vendas, Gerentes Gerais e pares comerciais um relatório de atividades realizadas, bem como a agenda de atividades previstas para a semana seguinte (seguir guia padrão).
  • Participar do fechamento mensal de vendas e colaborar na construção da apresentação de resultados, sempre que solicitado.
  • Fomentar o networking comercial por meio da participação em feiras, eventos, congressos, reuniões corporativas, rodadas de negócios, entre outros, representando a TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros.
  • Executar tarefas designadas pelo Head de Vendas ou Gerente Geral, com o objetivo de apoiar os hotéis da sua praça no cumprimento de suas metas.
  • Prestar contas de viagens e gastos extras de acordo com a política interna de viagens da TRUL HOTÉIS.

Para a vaga consideramos necessário:

  • Graduação completa em Turismo, Gestão em Hotelaria, Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins.
  • Vendas na área de Hotelaria ou Turismo.
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na área comercial.
  • Negociação com pequenas, médias, grandes contas.

Para a vaga consideramos desejável:

  • Vivência em hotéis de rede ou hotéis independentes;
  • Conhecimentos RM;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.

title: KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!
description:
KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!

Dit jaar starten we alweer aan het zevende bestuursjaar van onze stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig. Na de successen van voorgaande jaren in India, Malawi, Zambia en Sri Lanka, gaat KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig dit jaar vol voor stichting Estrela De Fuvela in Rio de Janeiro! Daarom gaan 30 KnappeKoppen dit jaar allemaal in hun eigen stad veel geld inzamelen zodat zij een uitbreiding van een klaslokaal van Estrela de Favela kunnen realiseren!

Lana, Wat is KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig eigenlijk?
KnappeKoppen is ooit ontstaan vanuit een initiatief van studenten uit Amsterdam en Utrecht. Zij wilden graag iets terug doen voor hun stad en anderen. Uit deze mooie visie ontstond Stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig, onderdeel van het commerciële bedrijf KnappeKoppen. Vier studenten vormden in 2018 samen het eerste stichtingsbestuur. Zij begonnen in hun eigen steden met lokale acties, zoals helpen bij de Voedselbank, ouderen een mooie dag bezorgen of kerstpakketten uitdelen. Later realiseerden ze zich dat ze impact wilden maken buiten hun eigen stadsmuren. Sindsdien zet het bestuur van de stichting zich ieder jaar in voor zowel hun eigen stad als voor een mooi (jaarlijks gekozen) internationaal doel.

Niek, waar denk jij dat in Rotterdam op dit moment de meeste behoefte is aan vrijwilligers?
Ik denk dat er in Rotterdam al veel mooie initiatieven zijn die zich inzetten voor de maatschappij. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan Stichting Betrokken Student en Oma’s Soep: twee mooie voorbeelden van organisaties die werken aan verbinding tussen de inwoners van Rotterdam. Toch is er op veel gebieden nog steeds een grote behoefte aan vrijwilligers.

Wij, als KnappeKoppen Rotterdam, zouden bijvoorbeeld maaltijdpakketten kunnen maken voor deze gezinnen of meehelpen bij een van de vele locaties van de Voedselbank. Daarnaast kunnen we soep rondbrengen naar eenzame ouderen en samen met hen een kop koffie drinken.

Sanna, kun je ons meenemen in de plannen voor komend jaar? Wat gaan jullie doen en waar ligt de focus op?
We hebben superveel leuke plannen voor het komende jaar! Een deel daarvan sluit aan bij de tijd van het jaar: zo denken we aan een Valentijnsactie, wijnflessen of kerstbomen verkopen rond de feestdagen en natuurlijk hutspotpakketten tijdens Leidens Ontzet.

Sterre, jullie hebben dit jaar gekozen voor stichting Estrela de Favela. Kun je iets meer vertellen over dit goede doel en waarom juist deze keuze is gemaakt?
Estrela de Favela is een stichting die zich inzet voor kansarme kinderen in de Braziliaanse favela’s. Zij bieden onderwijs aan kinderen van 5 tot 17 jaar, waarbij niet alleen aandacht wordt besteed aan de reguliere schoolvakken, maar ook aan ‘life skills’ en sociale vaardigheden.

Joep, wat is er allemaal nodig om het project te realiseren in Brazilië, en hoe kunnen mensen bijdragen of doneren?
Zoals Sterre vertelde, zetten wij ons dit jaar in om een nieuw klaslokaal mogelijk te maken voor kinderen in de favela! Het ingezamelde geld gaat naar de bouw en inrichting van deze plek, zodat kinderen een veilige omgeving krijgen om te leren, spelen en zich te ontwikkelen.

Keet, wat hopen jij en je bestuur dit jaar te bereiken, en hoe gaan jullie dat als team aanpakken?
Dit jaar willen wij in Groningen laten zien dat je naast je studie ook echt impact kunt maken, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Ons doel is om zoveel mogelijk studenten te betrekken bij onze acties, want hoe meer mensen meedoen, hoe groter het verschil.

Tot slot, Naomi! Hoe ga jij al deze besturen bijstaan dit studiejaar?
Dit jaar heb ik de eer om al deze fantastische KnappeKoppen te begeleiden als manager en te ondersteunen met zowel de lokale acties als natuurlijk het grote project in Rio de Janeiro voor Estrela de Favela waar Sterre jullie al meer over heeft verteld!

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go-to-market teams—as well as directly with top-tier Private Equity firms and enterprise-scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high-quality technical solutions.

The Team You'll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go-to-market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally,

  • You have 5+ years of full-stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS)
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Sushimeiro
description:
VEM SER NATURAL DA TERRA!

Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa.
Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria.

Todos os dias acordamos com um único objetivo: promover uma vida mais natural – em todos os sentidos.
Se você também acredita nesse propósito, vem com a gente!

SUSHIMEIRO
Escala: 6x1
Tipo de contrato: CLT

MISSÃO DO CARGO:
Realizar a limpeza e conservação de peixes e frutos do mar preparando variadas refeições da cozinha oriental, conforme sortimento da empresa, verificando e garantindo a qualidade, frescor, aparência, exposição e organização da área de vendas para atendimento dos nossos clientes.

ATIVIDADES DO CARGO:
• Manipular e higienizar os produtos, observando a qualidade e a validade dos itens, a fim de garantir o aproveitamento máximo dos insumos evitando desperdícios sem comprometer a qualidade
• Preparar sushis e sashimis, além de outros tipos de refeições do cardápio oriental definido pela empresa, separando e selecionando o produto a ser utilizado, garantindo a qualidade e satisfação do cliente
• Realizar a higienização do local de armazenamento, garantir o correto acondicionamento das mercadorias e verificar a qualidade e validade dos itens em estoque
• Seguir as normas estabelecidas pela Vigilância Sanitária e Manual de Boas Práticas

REQUISITOS:
• Ensino fundamental completo
• Experiência Anterior

INCLUSÃO E DIVERSIDADE
Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.
Valorizamos a diversidade e estamos de braços abertos para todos os talentos, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual.

Alimentação no local

Plano de saúde

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil.

Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG).
Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas.
Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.

O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois!

Nossa Missão:
Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil.

Nossos Valores são:
• Jogo aberto e íntegro
• Foco em resultado com qualidade
• Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso
• Excelência no Atendimento
• Jeito simples e alegre de ser
• Atitude Responsável

Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família!

Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo.

Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda.
